jp: 冒険者になれば、誰もが税金を払う。
jp_grezzo: "冒険者になれば、誰もが税金を払う。"
en: Everyone will pay for their taxes, you become an adventurer, you become the one who pays.
en_grezzo: "Everyone will pay for their taxes, you become an adventurer, you become the one who pays."
it: Se fai l'avventuriero, le tasse le paghi come tutti gli altri.

jp: 先払い分が今月でなくなった。
jp_grezzo: "先払い分が今月でなくなった。"
en: Your prepaid balance of tax payment has disappeared this month.
en_grezzo: "Your prepaid balance of tax payment has disappeared this month."
it: Il credito versato in anticipo è finito questo mese.

jp: 請求書が送られてきた。
en: A bill has been sent to your house.
en_grezzo: "A bill has been sent to your house."
it: È arrivata una fattura a casa tua.

jp: 今月分は既に納税している。
jp_grezzo: "今月分は既に納税している。"
en: Your prepaid balance covered the tax this month.
en_grezzo: "Your prepaid balance covered the tax this month."
it: Le tasse di questo mese le ha coperte il credito versato in anticipo.

jp: 早急にパルミア大使館まで行き、税金を納めなければならない。
jp_grezzo: "早急にパルミア大使館まで行き、税金を納めなければならない。"
en: You have to go to the Embassy of Palmia and pay tax at once.
en_grezzo: "You have to go to the Embassy of Palmia and pay tax at once."
it: Devi andare subito all'Ambasciata di Palmia a pagare le tasse.

jp: 税金をヶ月分滞納している。
jp_grezzo: "税金を" + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + "ヶ月分滞納している。"
en: You are in arrears with your tax for  months.
en_grezzo: "You are in arrears with your tax for " + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + " months."
contesto: txt s + lang("税金を" + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + "ヶ月分滞納している。", "You are in arrears with your tax for " + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + " months.") + s(1)
it: "Sei in arretrato con le tasse di " + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + " mesi."

jp: あなたは税金をヶ月滞納した罪で訴えられた。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは税金を" + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + "ヶ月滞納した罪で訴えられた。"
en: You have been accused for being in arrears with your tax for months.
en_grezzo: "You have been accused for being in arrears with your tax for" + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + " months."
contesto: txt lang("あなたは税金を" + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + "ヶ月滞納した罪で訴えられた。", "You have been accused for being in arrears with your tax for" + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + " months.")
it: "Ti hanno denunciato per non aver pagato le tasse di " + (gdata(GDATA_BILL) - 1) + " mesi."

contesto: txt lang("名声値を" + p + "失った。", "You lose " + p + " fame.")

jp: 陸と海の乗り物の維持費がリセットされた。それぞれ今月使った中で一番高額のものが次の税金に適用される。
jp_grezzo: "陸と海の乗り物の維持費がリセットされた。それぞれ今月使った中で一番高額のものが次の税金に適用される。"
en: Ship and vehicle maintenance costs have been reset. The most expensive ship and vehicle maintenance cost incurred this month will be applied to the next tax.
en_grezzo: "Ship and vehicle maintenance costs have been reset. The most expensive ship and vehicle maintenance cost incurred this month will be applied to the next tax."
it: I costi di mantenimento di mezzi e navi sono stati azzerati. Alle prossime tasse si applicano il mezzo e la nave più cari fra quelli usati questo mese.

jp: レベルが10に達していないので納税の義務はない。
jp_grezzo: "レベルが10に達していないので納税の義務はない。"
en: You don't have to pay tax until you hit level 10.
en_grezzo: "You don't have to pay tax until you hit level 10."
it: Fino al livello 10 non devi pagare le tasse.

jp: 初年度は納税の義務がない。
jp_grezzo: "初年度は納税の義務がない。"
en: You don't have to pay tax until New Year's.
en_grezzo: "You don't have to pay tax until New Year's."
it: Non devi pagare le tasse fino a Capodanno.
